name: Jackson Beck
source:
Nameable Main Protagonist (default name is Jackson)

Is in the Witness Protection Program after witnessing the murder of his dad's co-worker by a mob member.

From NYC.

His name before entering WitSec was Shelby.

Is a Cousin to Sadie.
